_about: Online look-ups of BOTH readings for each row on sheet 2 of OCR_accuracy_check_2026-10-15_plain.xlsx, done 15 Oct 2026. A real part number exists in the maker's catalogue and matches the item; a misread usually does not exist, or is a different part. Amayama = genuine-parts catalogue (Kia, Mercedes-Benz, Honda, Toyota); web = web search (Tesla, Mazda), less certain.

B01|4.finding: First reading 14205-08250B does not exist in the Kia catalogue. Second reading 14206-08250B is a Kia CLIP (S$1).

B01|5.finding: First reading 66570-H8400 does not exist. Second reading 86570-H8400 is STRIP-FR BUMPER for Kia Rio / Stonic, matching the bill's description.

B01|6.finding: Both numbers exist: 66311-H8400 and 66311-H8401 are both PANEL-FENDER, LH for Kia Rio / Stonic (two revisions of the same part). The second reading says the part-number column prints ...401 while the description text says ...400. Either way it is the same part, so the benchmark is not affected.

B01|10.finding: First reading KAB6812 H8 400 has a letter B where a digit belongs. Second reading 86812-H8400 is GUARD ASSY-FRONT WHEEL, RH for Kia Rio / Stonic, matching the description.

B03|3.finding: 1044341-00 is Tesla Model 3's front lower lateral link (current revision -D), matching 'FR LWR LAT'. First reading 1244341 was not found.

B11|missed.finding: HD71152-T6A-901 is a real Honda part: MOLDING, MIDDLE GRILLE UPPER for the Honda Odyssey (S$177.68). The look-up cannot tell which invoice it belongs to; the second reading says it is on page 2 as a separate invoice (8411268).

B17|1.finding: Neither GSKI-51-041A nor GSK1-51-041A is listed online (Mazda's '-51-041' means a headlamp). Mazda part-number prefixes use the digit 1 in this position (e.g. BHN2, EH47, KR22), so GSK1 is the likelier reading. Not confirmed.

B18|1.finding: A205 620 34 01 is BRACKET, LEFT for the Mercedes C-Class, matching the description. The leading '1' in the first reading is the quantity column read into the part number.

B31|1.finding: The first reading (1044341-00-E) is the number of the front lower lateral link, a different part. The second reading 1044841-00-E is the outer tie rod for Model 3 / Y, matching 'TIE ROD OUTER ASSY'.

B31|7.finding: Both readings say 1771986-SC-C, which does not exist. The left fender support bracket for Model 3 is 1771936-SC-C (right-hand version 1771937), same description and the same S$24.82 price on other bills. So both readings misread a 3 as a 9.

B31|8.finding: Neither 1894553-00-E nor 1504553-00-E was found online. Another Tesla bill in this check (B32) records the same item 'FRT WHEEL LINER ASSY, LH' at the same price (S$106.73) as 1694553-00-E, so both readings here may be wrong. Check the bill.

B31|15.finding: Neither 1894314-SC-G nor 1694314-SC-G was found online. Check the bill.

B34|15.finding: Both readings are the same Toyota part: 16711-30082 is SHROUD, FAN for the Hiace (S$103.50). The second reading's leading 'T' is from a tick mark over the first character; the printed number has no prefix. The benchmark is not affected either way.

B42|2.finding: First reading A253 880 02 28 is HINGE, RIGHT. Second reading A253 880 01 28 is HINGE, LEFT (both Mercedes GLC). The bill says 'HINGE BONNET LH', so the second reading matches.

B44|56.finding: Second reading 77930-T5A-J01 is SENSOR ASSY, FR. CRASH (Honda Fit / Jazz / HR-V / City and others). First reading 77930-T7A-J01 is not listed anywhere (T7A-C11 exists for the HR-V, but not -J01).
